output.headline: Hires Eide Bailly for $18,000 to audit 2017-18 school construction bond spending
output.summary: The district is hiring the accounting firm Eide Bailly, LLP to audit the 2017-18 finances and performance of its construction bond funds, which are overseen by the Facilities Planning and Management division. The contract is for $18,000 and is paid from Measure J bond money. The firm was chosen for its qualifications rather than on price, and work is scheduled to run from December 12, 2019 to April 30, 2020.

output.headline: Accepts $72,000 from Oakland Public Education Fund for Bridges Academy's school transformation plan
output.summary: The district is accepting a $72,000 grant, funded by Educate78 and passed through the Oakland Public Education Fund. The money supports the third year of Bridges Academy's three-year School Transformation Plan. The grant period runs from October 1, 2019 to June 5, 2020, which began before the board's vote.

output.headline: Hires Eide Bailly for $245,000 to audit 2018-19 school construction bond spending
output.summary: The district is hiring the accounting firm Eide Bailly, LLP to audit the 2018-19 finances and performance of its construction bond funds, which are overseen by the Facilities Planning and Management division. The contract is for $245,000 and is paid from Measure J bond money. The firm was chosen for its qualifications rather than on price, and work is scheduled to run from December 12, 2019 to December 30, 2020.

output.headline: Extends City of Oakland's Sobrante Park land lease 30 years to 2049 for park renovation
output.summary: The district is amending its ground lease with the City of Oakland for the recreation site at 470 El Paseo Drive so the city can carry out a community-led renovation of Sobrante Mini Park. The lease would run for 30 years from the date the board signs it, until 2049, and the city would have one option to renew for another 30 years. The text states no dollar amount, and all other lease terms stay the same.

output.headline: Supports applications for state funds for Fremont High's Arts, Media and Entertainment Academy facilities
output.summary: This resolution states the board's support for applications to reconfigure, build or modernize career technical education facilities at Fremont High School's Arts, Media and Entertainment Academy. The text does not give a dollar amount. The funding source is listed as the California Department of Education.

output.headline: Approves carrying over unspent 2018-19 Measure N college and career funds for each named school
output.summary: This resolution adopts the Measure N commission's recommendation to carry over the unspent 2018-19 Measure N fund balance, along with a plan for each named school. Measure N supports college and career readiness programs. The text gives no dollar amounts.
